OBSERVING in Mr. Pleauaut's paper of the 9th
in an advertisement of N. J. Poitiaux, OF
service for sale under deed of trust, the house and
lot, whereon now resides, therefore think it ne
cessary to inform all persons inclined TO purchase,
that good title cannot be made TO the property
under the said trust, as there is no, only prior
claim by mortgage upon it, granted Mr. Benjamin
Day of Fredericksburg, to secure the payment of
certain bonds of Mr. Degorgue, but there is
suit instituted against me in the district court by
Mr. Stegar, for the same; and as I have obtained
legal possession of the said property, by deed in
fee, determined hold it until the title shall
be legally investigated and established, or the pay
ment, have made in part, of the purchase refunded.


John Fremont.


October 15, 1800.
